newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Tourism reports first half loss. [CORRECTED 13:17 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Tourism reports first half loss. [CORRECTED 13:17 GMT]

text.p: (In thousands of Cyprus pounds, apart from dividend,
(Corrects to make clear comparative figures are for full year 1995 not first half.)
NOTE - Full company name is the Cyprus Tourism Development Company Ltd, owners of the Cyprus Hilton Hotel in Nicosia.
Losses in first half 1996 primarily due to the decrease in tourism, increased interest on loans and increased loan repayments due to the expansion and renovation of the Hilton Hotel.
Comparative figures for the first half of 1995 are not available.
Results for the second half of the year are expected to fluctuate around the same levels, the company said, adding there would be no dividends in 1996.
